import hashlib

import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import time

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
OUT = ROOT / '.scratch/perf6'
TREE = OUT / 'bisect-tree'
variants = [('round4', '41e53e4'), ('wake', 'e9333a9'),
            ('config', '2bec7a2'), ('merge', 'a3ddb7b'), ('round5', '95ea79d')]
records = []
for name, commit in variants:
    subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(TREE), 'switch', '--detach', commit], check=True)
    start = time.time()
    env = dict(os.environ, CARGO_TARGET_DIR=str(ROOT / 'target'))
    subprocess.run(['cargo', 'build', '--release', '-p', 'vmlab-hv', '-j', '8'],

import argparse
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import statistics
import sys
import tempfile
import time

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'bench'))
import backends
import lib
import netpeer
import run

OUT = ROOT / '.scratch/perf6'


def measure(name, binary, mode, cohort, samples):
    args = argparse.Namespace(backend='qemu' if name == 'qemu' else 'vmlab-hv',
                              timeout_scale=1.0, hv_bin=binary, keep=False)
    record = dict(name=name, binary=binary, mode=mode, cohort=cohort,
                  load_start=lib.read_loadavg(), started=time.time(), samples=[])
    if binary:
        record['sha256'] = hashlib.sha256(Path(binary).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='hv-perf6-', dir='/tmp') as directory:
        peer = backend = agent = None
        try:
            overlay, code, variables = lib.prepare_run_dir(
                directory, 'x86_64', 'ubuntu-26.04', lib.latest_template('x86_64', 'ubuntu-26.04'))
            net = lib.BENCH_NET
            peer = netpeer.Peer(directory, net['guest_ip'], net['guest_mac'], net['port'])
            params = (directory, 'ubuntu-26.04', 2, '16-23', overlay, code,
                      variables, peer.switch_sock, net['guest_mac'], net['mtu'], run.log)
            backend = (backends.X86QemuBackend(*params) if name == 'qemu' else
                       backends.X86HvBackend(*params, binary, lib.IPXE_ROM))
            lib.require_vm_slots()
            session = backend.launch()
            backend.release_cpus()
            agent, hello, boot = run.wait_x86_ready(backend, args, 'ubuntu-26.04', directory, session.t0)
            record['boot_seconds'] = boot
            run.sh(agent, 'timeout 90 cloud-init status --wait >/dev/null 2>&1 || true')
            nic = run.guest_nic(agent)
            run.must_sh(agent, f"ip addr replace {net['guest_ip']}/24 dev {nic} && "
                        f"ip link set dev {nic} mtu {net['mtu']} && ip link set {nic} up", 'NIC setup')
            run.copy_in_tools(agent, netpeer.randblke_path())
            record['features'] = run.sh(agent, f'cat /sys/class/net/{nic}/device/features')[1]
            for index in range(samples):
                if mode == 'udp':
                    peer.report()
                    out = run.must_sh(agent,
                        f"python3 /tmp/vmlab-nettool.py udp-blast {net['peer_ip']} {net['port']} "
                        f"{net['udp_payload']} {run.NET_WINDOW}", 'UDP TX', timeout=60)
                    blast = json.loads(out.strip().splitlines()[-1])
                    time.sleep(run.NET_SETTLE)
                    received = peer.report()
                    assert blast['bytes'] and received['rx_bytes'] >= 0.9 * blast['bytes'], (blast, received)
                    value = received['rx_bytes'] * 8 / run.NET_WINDOW / 1e6
                    detail = dict(blast=blast, received=received)
                elif mode == 'rx':
                    run.must_sh(agent,
                        f'rm -f /tmp/sink.json; nohup python3 /tmp/vmlab-nettool.py udp-sink {net["port"]} '
                        f'{run.NET_WINDOW + 8} > /tmp/sink.json 2>&1 &', 'start UDP sink')
                    time.sleep(run.NET_SETTLE)
                    def counter():
                        return int(run.must_sh(agent, f'cat /sys/class/net/{nic}/statistics/rx_bytes', 'RX counter'))
                    before = counter()
                    peer.blast(run.NET_WINDOW, net['udp_payload'])
                    previous = None
                    deadline = time.monotonic() + run.NET_WINDOW + 30
                    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
                        current = counter()
                        if previous is not None and current == previous:
                            break
                        previous = current
                        time.sleep(2)
                    detail = dict(before=before, after=current)
                    value = (current - before) * 8 / run.NET_WINDOW / 1e6
                    run.sh(agent, 'pkill -f vmlab-nettool || true')
                else:
                    out = run.must_sh(agent,
                        f'/tmp/randblke seqwrite /var/tmp/perf6-seq-{index}.img {run.BLK_SEQ_MIB * 1048576}',
                        'sequential write', timeout=180)
                    detail = json.loads(out.strip().splitlines()[-1])
                    value = detail['bytes'] / 1048576 / detail['secs']
                    run.must_sh(agent, f'rm /var/tmp/perf6-seq-{index}.img', 'remove measured file')
                record['samples'].append(dict(value=value, detail=detail, load=lib.read_loadavg()))
                print(json.dumps(dict(name=name, mode=mode, cohort=cohort, index=index, value=value)), flush=True)
            record['median'] = statistics.median(s['value'] for s in record['samples'])
        finally:
            if agent is not None:
                agent.close()
            if backend is not None and hasattr(backend, 'session'):
                if name != 'qemu':
                    try:
                        backend.quit()
                    except Exception:
                        pass
                backend.session.kill()
            if peer is not None:
                peer.kill()
            dest = OUT / 'logs' / f'{mode}-{cohort}-{name}-{int(record["started"])}'
            dest.mkdir(parents=True)
            for entry in Path(directory).iterdir():
                if entry.is_file() and entry.suffix in ('.json', '.log'):
                    shutil.copy2(entry, dest / entry.name)
            record['load_end'] = lib.read_loadavg()
            record['finished'] = time.time()
            with (OUT / 'measurements.jsonl').open('a') as output:
                output.write(json.dumps(record) + '\n')
    return record


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('mode', choices=['udp', 'seq', 'rx'])
    parser.add_argument('variants', nargs='+')
    parser.add_argument('--cohorts', type=int, default=3)
    parser.add_argument('--samples', type=int, default=3)
    opts = parser.parse_args()
    netpeer.compile_tools(run.log)
    locks = []
    for slot in range(2):
        path = Path(f'/tmp/vmlab-hv-vm-slots-{os.getuid()}/{slot}.lock')
        handle = path.open('a+')
        fcntl.flock(handle, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        locks.append(handle)
    for cohort in range(opts.cohorts):
        order = opts.variants[cohort % len(opts.variants):] + opts.variants[:cohort % len(opts.variants)]
        for name in order:
            binary = None if name == 'qemu' else str(OUT / 'bin' / name / 'vmlab-hv')
            measure(name, binary, opts.mode, cohort, opts.samples)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

s=socket.socket();s.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET,socket.SO_REUSEADDR,1)

 if not b:break

print(json.dumps(dict(bytes=n,sha256=h.hexdigest())),flush=True)
'''
SEND = '''import hashlib,json,random,socket,sys
r=random.Random(5971);s=socket.create_connection((sys.argv[1],5910));h=hashlib.sha256();n=0
for i in range(32):
 b=r.randbytes(1048576);s.sendall(b);h.update(b);n+=len(b)
s.close();print(json.dumps(dict(bytes=n,sha256=h.hexdigest())))
'''


def measure(name, cohort, check):
    versions = name.split('+')
    if len(versions) == 1:
        versions *= 2
    assert len(versions) == 2
    record = dict(name=name, cohort=cohort, mode='tcp', load_start=lib.read_loadavg(), samples={}, guests=[])
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='hv-perf6-tcp-', dir='/tmp') as directory:
        hub = netpeer.Hub(directory)
        machines, agents = [], []
        try:
            for tag, pin in [('a', '16-19'), ('b', '20-23')]:
                version = versions[len(machines)]
                binary = str(OUT / 'bin' / version / 'vmlab-hv')
                args = argparse.Namespace(backend='qemu' if version == 'qemu' else 'vmlab-hv',
                                          hv_bin=binary, timeout_scale=1.0)
                child = Path(directory) / tag
                child.mkdir()
                backend = run.g2g_launch(args, tag, 'ubuntu-26.04', 2, pin,
                    hub.switch_sock, lib.BENCH_NET[f'g2g_{tag}_mac'], str(child))
                machines.append(backend)
                agent, _ = lib.wait_for_agent(backend.agent_socket(), 300, vm_exited=backend.session.exit_code)
                agents.append(agent)
                run.sh(agent, 'timeout 90 cloud-init status --wait >/dev/null 2>&1 || true')
                run.g2g_setup_guest(agent, lib.BENCH_NET[f'g2g_{tag}_ip'])
                nic = run.guest_nic(agent)
                info = dict(version=version, nic=nic,
                    features=run.must_sh(agent, f'cat /sys/class/net/{nic}/device/features', 'feature query'),
                    offloads=run.must_sh(agent, f'ethtool -k {nic}', 'offload query'),
                    statistics_before=run.must_sh(agent, f'ethtool -S {nic}', 'statistics query'))
                if version != 'qemu':
                    info['sha256'] = hashlib.sha256(Path(binary).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                record['guests'].append(info)
            directions = [(0, 1, 'a2b', lib.BENCH_NET['g2g_b_ip']),
                          (1, 0, 'b2a', lib.BENCH_NET['g2g_a_ip'])]
            for source, target, direction, ip in directions:
                rate, blast, sink = run.g2g_direction(agents[source], agents[target], ip, 5903, run.NET_WINDOW)
                assert blast['bytes'] == sink['bytes'] and sink['bytes'] > 0, (blast, sink)
                record['samples'][direction] = dict(value=rate, blast=blast, sink=sink)
                print(json.dumps(dict(name=name, cohort=cohort, direction=direction, rate=rate)), flush=True)
            for info, agent in zip(record['guests'], agents):
                info['statistics_after'] = run.must_sh(agent, f'ethtool -S {info["nic"]}', 'statistics query')
            if check:
                for info, agent in zip(record['guests'], agents):
                    setup = ('set -e; mountpoint -q /sys/kernel/tracing || '
                        'mount -t tracefs nodev /sys/kernel/tracing; '
                        "printf 'p:perf6_tx_csum skb_checksum_help\\np:perf6_rx_csum __skb_checksum_complete\\n"
                        "p:perf6_rx_gro __skb_gro_checksum_complete\\n' "
                        '>> /sys/kernel/tracing/kprobe_events; '
                        'echo 1 > /sys/kernel/tracing/events/kprobes/perf6_tx_csum/enable; '
                        'echo 1 > /sys/kernel/tracing/events/kprobes/perf6_rx_csum/enable; '
                        'echo 1 > /sys/kernel/tracing/events/kprobes/perf6_rx_gro/enable; '
                        'cat /sys/kernel/tracing/kprobe_profile')
                    info['probe_setup'] = run.sh(agent, setup)
                    info['probe_before'] = run.sh(agent, 'cat /sys/kernel/tracing/kprobe_profile')
                for source, target, direction, ip in directions:
                    for agent in agents:
                        run.must_sh(agent, 'cat > /tmp/check-receive.py', 'copy receiver', stdin_data=RECEIVE.encode())
                        run.must_sh(agent, 'cat > /tmp/check-send.py', 'copy sender', stdin_data=SEND.encode())
                    run.must_sh(agents[target], 'rm -f /tmp/check-ready /tmp/check.json; '
                        'nohup python3 /tmp/check-receive.py > /tmp/check.json 2>&1 &', 'start byte-exact sink')
                    run.must_sh(agents[target], 'while [ ! -f /tmp/check-ready ]; do sleep 0.05; done', 'wait for sink')
                    sent = json.loads(run.must_sh(agents[source], f'python3 /tmp/check-send.py {ip}', 'byte-exact transfer'))
                    received = json.loads(run.must_sh(agents[target],
                        'while [ ! -s /tmp/check.json ]; do sleep 0.05; done; cat /tmp/check.json',
                        'read byte-exact result'))
                    assert sent == received and sent['bytes'] == 32 * 1048576, (sent, received)
                    record['samples'][direction]['byte_exact'] = received
                for info, agent in zip(record['guests'], agents):
                    info['probe_after'] = run.sh(agent, 'cat /sys/kernel/tracing/kprobe_profile')
        finally:
            run.g2g_teardown(machines, agents)
            hub.kill()
            dest = OUT / 'logs' / f'tcp-{cohort}-{name}-{int(time.time())}'
            dest.mkdir(parents=True)
            for tag in ['a', 'b']:
                child = Path(directory) / tag
                if child.exists():
                    (dest / tag).mkdir()
                    for entry in child.iterdir():
                        if entry.is_file() and entry.suffix in ('.json', '.log'):
                            shutil.copy2(entry, dest / tag / entry.name)
            record['load_end'] = lib.read_loadavg()
            with (OUT / 'tcp.jsonl').open('a') as output:

    parser.add_argument('--cohorts', type=int, default=3)
    parser.add_argument('--check', action='store_true')
    opts = parser.parse_args()
    netpeer.compile_tools()
    locks = []
    for slot in range(2):

        fcntl.flock(handle, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        locks.append(handle)
